name: Fastino-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-Finance
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1048576). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
activation: relu2 (MLP and MoE); silu in the Mamba-2 path
attention_variant: hybrid Mamba-2 + LatentMoE + GQA: 40 Mamba-2, 40 MoE, 8 attention (of 88 blocks); vision via C-RADIO v4-H
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16, not a new base model: same config.json, same 123.611 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-14. Caveats: merged LoRA (rank 32, 75.2M trainable) on the language backbone only - the vision encoder of the VL base is NOT included, so it is a text model despite the base being vision-language; recorded as text-generation. Base column is the same early-access Super checkpoint. Single training run, single evaluation run.
